params.name: q
params.description: Search payments by ID, external_payment_id, receiver wallet address, or disbursement name.

params.name: page_limit
params.description: Define how many results will be returned in the response.

params.name: status
params.description: Exact match on the status of the payment.

params.name: receiver_id
params.description: UUID that represents a receiver in the database

params.name: created_at_after
params.description: Only return payments that are created after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: created_at_before
params.description: Only return payments that are created before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

items.docs: Returns all individual payments matching the request criteria. This endpoint supports pagination, and filtering on payment status, type, receiver ID, and timestamp. Each payment has details on the transaction itself, receiver, disbursement, asset, status history, and blockchain information.
Creates a new direct payment that is immediately sent to the specified receiver if they have a valid registered wallet. Direct payments bypass the disbursement workflow and are processed instantly.
Fetches detailed information on a specific payment by  `id `.
Cancels a payment by setting its status to `CANCELED`.

params.name: transaction_hash
params.description: Transactions are commands that modify the ledger state and consist of one or more operations.

params.name: cursor
params.description: A number that points to a specific location in a collection of responses and is pulled from the paging_token value of a record.

params.name: order
params.description: A designation of the order in which records should appear. Options include `asc` (ascending) or `desc` (descending). If this argument isn’t set, it defaults to `asc`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of records returned. The limit can range from 1 to 200 - an upper limit that is hardcoded in Horizon for performance reasons. If this argument isn’t designated, it defaults to 10.

items.docs: This endpoint returns the payments of a specific transaction.
